## Problem

What concrete problem does this change address?

## Change

What changes for a user or contributor? State the scope and any deliberate limitations.

## Verification

List the exact revision and commands or manual checks used, with their outcomes.
Distinguish failures, skipped checks, and behavior that was not evaluated.
For documentation-only changes, check links, commands against their source, and capability claims.

## Review

Identify a non-author reviewer and the exact revision reviewed when required by
[GOVERNANCE.md](https://github.com/Ayyitskevin/beacon/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md). Record any required Product Steward decision.
Public contracts, domain language, security, authority, persistence, compatibility, and
governance changes require the proposal and decision process described there.

## Related evidence

Link the issue, implementation checkpoint, or decision record when applicable.
